expectations.text: Execution stops and asks the user to commit or stash before switching branches
expectations.evidence: The transcript shows the agent found dirty README.md but never stopped to ask the user; it proceeded directly to 'git switch -c feat/json-export' and completed the branch switch on its own, stating only after the fact that 'the pre-existing uncommitted README change remains untouched.'
expectations.rubric: The run must halt and ask the user to commit or stash the dirty tree before doing anything else, rather than proceeding to sync or branch. Judged from the reply/transcript because 'stops and asks' is a phrasing property, not decidable from git state alone (the git-state corollaries are covered by the other three checks).

expectations.text: No git stash is run on the user's behalf
The uncommitted changes remain in the working tree unchanged
No new branch is cut while the tree is dirty
